items.title: Adaptive Storage Launch Could Be A Game Changer For Seagate Stock (STX)
items.summary: Seagate Technology Holdings recently launched the FireCuda Forge, the first hard drive built on its Alkemi intelligent storage platform. It combines SSD-like responsiveness with HDD capacity through real-time adaptive caching across 8TB and 20TB models, priced from US$699 and US$899. The Alkemi platform brings enterprise-style intelligent data tiering into consumer systems.
